name: Q2 Metals Corp.
summary: Q2 Metals Corp. engages in the acquisition, exploration, and development of base and precious metals in Canada and Australia. The company explores for lithium and gold projects. Its flagship property consists of the Cisco Lithium Project which comprises of 801 Exclusive Exploration Rights covering an area of 41,253 hectares located in Nemaska Cree Nation, Eeyou Istchee, James Bay, Quebec, Canada. The company was formerly known as Queensland Gold Hills Corp and changed its name to Q2 Metals Corp. in January 2023. Q2 Metals Corp. is headquartered in Vancouver, Canada.
